title: Review of c52's third-trophic-level negative on fresh seeds 21 and 22: replicates; top predators settle on every prey within ~500 t of being added, the predator bodies vanish and nothing divides afterwards
summary: Labkit runs of world3.py, defaults, 128^2, t=12000, seeds 21 and 22. Top-predator bodies 0 -> 44-45 within ~500 t of their addition at t=4000 and stay (final 43 and 42, persistent 44 and 41, 0 splits); predator bodies 45 -> 0 by t~4500-5000 (final 0, 0 persistent tracks); prey 41.6 and 41.5 bodies on average, 8 and 5 persistent splits, all before or just after t=4000 (cumulative splits flat after t=4000 on seed 21). Total predator material stays constant (channel totals) while held below threshold.

observations.D: rerun/seed21/timeseries.png and rerun/seed22/FACTS.md: top 0 persistent splits, predators 0 bodies after t~5000, prey splits stop after t~4000 (8 and 5 persistent splits in all)

verdicts.limitation: Default parameters only; I did not rerun the two-level control or the parameter variants, and did not measure the predator material held inside the top bodies.
